search_audit.query: Open 字 — historical form and meaning
search_audit.outcome: Bronze 字 shows 子 beneath 宀, raising a child indoors, with 子 also phonetic. Early texts use it for birth and nurture. A Han explanation connects written characters with signs multiplying from earlier forms. Later 字 commonly means a written character. Browser text extraction failed on a subsequent open; full page was fetched directly with requests and the 形義通解 section read successfully.
